text: Program Description Maximum of 15 students are grouped in a class for language courses. There are various course for the students with different Chinese level. Applicants could take the course which is suitable for yourself. Beginner: Comprehensive C, Chinese Listening, Spoken Chinese Elementary: Elementary Comprehensive Chinese, Elementary Chinese Reading, Elementary Spoken Chinese, Elementary Chinese Listening Intermediate: Intermediate Comprehensive Chinese, Intermediate Chinese Reading, Intermediate Spoken Chinese, Intermediate Chinese Listening Advanced: Advanced Comprehensive Chinese, Chinese Idioms, Chinese Culture, Chinese Reading, Chinese Newspaper Reading, Introduction to Chinese History Fetures of Chinese language program 1) Classroom teaching: Students are entitled to choose to join in a mass class or a one-to-one class on the basis of their Chinese levels and their own wishes. 2) After-class assistance with Chinese learning: A Chinese tutor will be appointed on any international student's request. 3) Flexible entry time: twice of entry and registration in March and September respectively, or prompt entry upon the arrival of the international students at any time of the year.
